001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.query;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006
007import java.util.ArrayList;
008import java.util.Collection;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.function.Predicate;
011
012/**
013 * Composable in-memory shop query.
014 *
015 * <p>The no-argument execute method queries all known shops. The collection overload lets callers
016 * query a pre-scoped market, owner, tag, or world result without touching Bukkit state.</p>
017 */
018public final class ShopQuery {
019
020  private final List<Predicate<Shop>> filters = new ArrayList<>();
021
022  public <T> @NotNull ShopQuery filterBy(@NotNull final Filter<T> filter, @NotNull final T value) {
023
024    filters.add(shop -> filter.applies(shop, value));
025    return this;
026  }
027
028  public @NotNull ShopQuery filter(@NotNull final Predicate<Shop> filter) {
029
030    filters.add(filter);
031    return this;
032  }
033
034  public @NotNull List<Shop> execute() {
035
036    return execute(QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().getAllShops());
037  }
038
039  public @NotNull List<Shop> execute(@NotNull final Collection<? extends Shop> source) {
040
041    final List<Shop> shops = new ArrayList<>();
042    for(final Shop shop : source) {
043      boolean matches = true;
044      for(final Predicate<Shop> filter : filters) {
045        if(!filter.test(shop)) {
046          matches = false;
047          break;
048        }
049      }
050      if(matches) {
051        shops.add(shop);
052      }
053    }
054    return shops;
055  }
056}
